```{r}
save_var_path <- 'C:/Users/DBT3KD/Desktop/Etude_macro_elec/prix_electricite_gitlab/Data_structuring/output'
setwd(save_var_path)
IV_data <- read_parquet('IV_data_fr.parquet')
```


```{r}
colnames(IV_data)
```

```{r}
IV_data <- IV_data %>% 
  mutate(spot_price_diff = spot_price - lag(spot_price))

ggplot(IV_data) +
  geom_line(aes(x = datetime, y = spot_price_diff, color = "elec")) +
  geom_line(aes(x = datetime, y = avg_spot_diff, color = "gas")) +
  geom_line(aes(x = datetime, y = last_spot_diff, color = "gas"), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_line(aes(x = datetime, y = PC1_supply*30, color = "instrument"), linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "Spot price difference",
       x = "Date",
       y = "Spot price difference (€/MWh)")
```


```{r}
IV_data %>% 
  mutate(spot_price_diff_lag = lag(spot_price_diff),
         spot_price_diff_lead = lead(spot_price_diff)
         ) %>%
  dplyr::select(avg_spot_diff, spot_price_diff, 
         spot_price_diff_lag, spot_price_diff_lead) %>%
  cor(use = "complete.obs")
```


```{r}
supply_model <- lm(avg_spot_diff  ~ PC1_supply, 
                  #last_spot_diff  ~ Fund,
                   data = IV_data)

summary(supply_model)


```

```{r}
supply_model <- lm(spot_price_diff  ~ PC1_supply, 
                  #last_spot_diff  ~ Fund,
                   data = IV_data)

summary(supply_model)

```


```{r}

ggplot(data = IV_data)+
  geom_line(aes(x = datetime, y = wind_forecast, color = "Wind"))+
  geom_line(aes(x = datetime, y = solar_forecast, color = "Solar"))+
  geom_line(aes(x = datetime, y = spot_price*10, color = "elec"))+
  geom_line(aes(x = datetime, y = T_avg*1000, color = "T(°C)"))+
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r}

model <- lm(data = IV_data %>% 
              mutate(renewable_forecast_diff = 
                       renewable_forecast - lag(renewable_forecast),
                     predicted_unavailabilities_diff =
                       predicted_unavailabilities - lag(predicted_unavailabilities),
                     spot_price_diff = spot_price - lag(spot_price)),
   formula = spot_price_diff ~ PC1_supply + renewable_forecast_diff +predicted_unavailabilities_diff
   )
summary(model)
```
```{r}

model <- lm(data = IV_data %>% 
              mutate(renewable_forecast_diff = 
                       renewable_forecast - lag(renewable_forecast),
                     spot_price_diff = spot_price - lag(spot_price),
            predicted_unavailabilities_diff =
                       predicted_unavailabilities - lag(predicted_unavailabilities)),
   formula = spot_price_diff ~ PC1_supply + renewable_forecast_diff+ predicted_unavailabilities_diff+
     cold_excess_instrument + heat_excess_instrument
   )

summary(model)
```

# Instrumenting the demand side of the market 


```{r}


model <- lm(data = IV_data %>% 
              mutate(renewable_forecast_diff = 
                       renewable_forecast - lag(renewable_forecast),
                     gen_tot_diff = gen_tot - lag(gen_tot),
            predicted_unavailabilities_diff =
                       predicted_unavailabilities - lag(predicted_unavailabilities)),
   formula = gen_tot_diff ~ PC1_supply + renewable_forecast_diff+ predicted_unavailabilities_diff+
     cold_excess_instrument + heat_excess_instrument
   )   

summary(model)
```
